name: cinder-monorepo
description: Cinder React Component Library & Showcase Monorepo

scripts.build: node init && npm run build:packages && npm run build:web
scripts.build:packages: node init && npm run build --workspace=@tec-triad/iconforge-core && npm run build --workspace=@tec-triad/iconforge-svg && npm run build --workspace=@tec-triad/iconforge-react && npm run build --workspace=@tec-triad/cinder-ui
scripts.publish:packages: npm publish --workspace=@tec-triad/iconforge-core --access public && npm publish --workspace=@tec-triad/iconforge-svg --access public && npm publish --workspace=@tec-triad/iconforge-react --access public && npm publish --workspace=@tec-triad/cinder-ui --access public
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@tec-triad/iconforge-core && npm run typecheck --workspace=@tec-triad/iconforge-react && npm run typecheck --workspace=@tec-triad/cinder-ui && npm run typecheck --workspace=@cinder-ui/web
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules packages/*/dist packages/*/node_modules apps/*/dist apps/*/node_modules
